schema_version: 1
commands:
  policy:
    run: ./.ai/scripts/check-agent-policy.sh
    requires_approval: false
    risk: verification
  format_check:
    run: test -z "$(gofmt -l $(rg --files -g '*.go' cmd internal))"
    requires_approval: false
    risk: verification
  unit_test:
    run: go test ./internal/domain/... ./internal/application/... ./internal/transport/http/...
    requires_approval: false
    risk: verification
    note: Unit and httptest packages only; must not connect to PostgreSQL or external services.
  vet:
    run: go vet ./...
    requires_approval: false
    risk: verification
  build:
    run: go build -o /tmp/ms-go-practice-runtime ./cmd/ms-go-practice-runtime
    requires_approval: false
    risk: verification
  postgres_integration:
    run: go test -tags=integration ./internal/infrastructure/persistence/...
    requires_approval: true
    risk: database_access
  run:
    run: go run ./cmd/ms-go-practice-runtime
    requires_approval: true
    risk: external_runtime
  migrate_up:
    run: task migrate-up
    requires_approval: true
    risk: database_write
    note: Placeholder until serialized integration wiring provides a migration runner and task.
  migrate_down:
    run: task migrate-down
    requires_approval: true
    risk: destructive_database_write
    note: Placeholder until serialized integration wiring provides a migration runner and task. Review the matching down migration before use.
